snippet.title: STRANGE BREW - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam ➫ http://s.team/a/3499670

Escape zombies and chase coffees! Play as Joe the Duck, a mascot, who must outmaneuver and outwit the brainless mobs. Run to survive the horrific launch of a new pumpkin spice latte. Destroy the company town to win a moment’s peace with your morning cup.

Strange Brew is a 3D action platformer with an arcade feel. Risk death as you dodge and dash to the safety of the next MoonDucks coffee shop. Activate traps that cause blood and feathers. Test your reflexes to avoid the relentless zombie onslaught.

COMING SOON - Wishlist now on Steam ➫ http://s.team/a/3499670

RUN FROM THE DECAFFEINATED
Drop or throw coffee beans to lure and trick zombie hordes. Be clever. To top the leaderboard, Joe must take risks to orchestrate mass murders for monster point totals.

KILL ‘EM ALL, IF YOU MUST
Expect to always be chased and harassed. Swat through the chaos, leap from tall buildings, and make good use of environmental hazards. Save yourself to take the fight to them.

EMBRACE THE MADNESS
Strange Brew is awash in atmospherics and cinematic moments. Find yourself behind the DJ booth at a warehouse rave, or atop a monorail screaming out of control, or summiting the nuclear cooling tower. Drink it up!

FEEL FREE TO REPLAY
Seek different paths to unlock secrets, like fabulous additional costumes.  Switch to the 68' Living Dead Mode to experience this apocalypse in black-and-white.
